stories.label: Iran war Day 6+: Multi-front regional conflict — Lebanon, Gulf, energy crisis
stories.summary: Day 6: War continues across multiple fronts. Israel shuts Al-Aqsa for 3rd day of Ramadan. Fourth US service member dead. Iran death toll 555+. Hegseth won't rule out ground troops. Qatar LNG halted, Hormuz closed, AWS data centers destroyed in Dubai.

stories.label: Khamenei killed: interim council active, succession race underway
stories.summary: Interim council (Arafi, president, chief justice) leading Iran. Khamenei's wife also died from injuries. Assembly of Experts hasn't convened. Succession crisis ongoing amid active war.

stories.label: Iran school strike: death toll 180+, total 555+ killed across 131 cities
stories.summary: Total Iran civilian death toll 555+ (Red Crescent). School strike toll 180+. 131 cities affected. War crimes evidence mounting.

stories.label: Hormuz shut, Qatar LNG halted, European gas doubled, AWS data centers destroyed
stories.summary: Qatar halted LNG production after Iranian attacks. European gas nearly doubled. Hormuz still shut. AWS Dubai data centers on fire — first major cloud outage from warfare. Oil surging. Europe's switch from Russian gas to Gulf LNG now stress-tested.

stories.label: Most Americans oppose Iran war — Democrats fracturing over Israel
stories.summary: Only 25% of Americans approve strikes. Democrats fracturing — AIPAC money vs peace wing dominating primaries. War launched without congressional authorization.

stories.label: Lebanon bans Hezbollah military activities — historic but enforcement uncertain
stories.summary: Lebanon's PM banned Hezbollah military activities — unprecedented. Driven by Israel's escalation (18+ village evacuation orders) and Hezbollah breaking Nov 2024 ceasefire. Enforcement mechanism unclear.

stories.label: Macron expands France's nuclear arsenal, offers nuclear aircraft to allies
stories.summary: Macron: 'To be free, we have to be feared.' France expanding nuclear arsenal and offering nuclear-armed aircraft deployment to allies. Biggest shift in European nuclear posture since Cold War. Driven by US distraction with Iran and wavering NATO credibility.

stories.label: Israel shuts Al-Aqsa for 3+ days during Ramadan under Iran war cover
stories.summary: Al-Aqsa Mosque closed for 3 consecutive days during Ramadan. Collective punishment of Palestinian worshippers. Combined with sealed Gaza crossings, settler violence (2 brothers killed in Nablus). Iran war providing cover.

stories.label: El Niño may return in 2026, stacking warming on record temperatures
stories.summary: Forecasters warn El Niño may return in 2026 after last event helped push temperatures past 1.5°C. Would mean hottest period ever gets hotter. Consequences heaviest for Global South.

stories.label: AWS data centers in Dubai destroyed by Iranian missiles — first cloud outage from warfare
stories.summary: Iranian missiles set AWS Dubai data centers on fire. First time major cloud infrastructure physically destroyed by warfare. Services down across Middle East. Exposes fragility of digital infrastructure in geopolitically unstable regions.

stories.label: Pre-solar crystals in meteorites reveal solar system's violent birth
stories.summary: Crystals in meteorites predate the Sun itself — forged in dying stars. Chemical signatures rewriting understanding of the solar system's earliest moments.

stories.label: 170 killed in South Sudan's Ruweng — MSF staff missing
stories.summary: ~170 killed in single attack in Ruweng, South Sudan. MSF staff missing. One of deadliest incidents in ongoing conflict. Ethnic territorial disputes in oil-rich region. Global attention consumed by Iran.

stories.label: Suspected insiders made $1.2M betting on Iran strikes via prediction markets
stories.summary: Suspected insiders made $1.2M on Polymarket betting on Iran strikes. Israeli police investigating. Total war-related bets hit $529M.

stories.label: India's $60bn river storage plan threatens Pakistan's water supply
stories.summary: India investing $60bn in storage on rivers flowing into Pakistan. Indus Waters Treaty (1960) under strain. 200M+ downstream affected.

stories.label: Gaza sealed: crossings closed, Al-Aqsa shut, aid halted under Iran war cover
stories.summary: All crossings sealed. 37 aid orgs halted. Al-Aqsa shut for 3 days during Ramadan. Settler violence continuing. Total siege under Iran war cover.

stories.label: Pakistan triple crisis: Iran protests, Afghan border war, domestic unrest
stories.summary: 24+ dead in pro-Iran protests. Troops deployed, 3-day curfew imposed. Afghanistan border war continuing. Three-way crisis.

stories.label: Mass graves in eastern DRC after M23 withdrawal
stories.summary: Mass graves found near Uvira after M23 withdrawal. Rwanda hasn't responded.

stories.label: Anthropic rejects Pentagon — AI reportedly used in Iran strikes anyway
stories.summary: Anthropic rejected Pentagon demand. SCMP reports AI used in Iran strikes regardless. Story dormant amid active war coverage.

stories.label: Pakistan-Afghanistan border war — fighting enters fifth day
stories.summary: Fighting entering fifth day. No signs of de-escalation per Al Monitor.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia war — peace talks expected this week, attention diverted
stories.summary: Zelensky says peace talks still expected this week despite Iran war consuming attention. Russian strikes at 3-year peak. Urgently needs return to coverage.

stories.label: Sudan war — fading from global attention
stories.summary: Crisis continues. Iran war consuming all bandwidth. South Sudan massacre (170 killed) is separate but related regional instability.

stories.label: DNA reveals one-directional Neanderthal-human interbreeding pattern
stories.summary: Interbreeding was one-directional: Neanderthal fathers, human mothers. One-off research finding.

stories.label: Selfish gene may bias sex ratio — Utah family has 2x boys
stories.summary: Utah family produces 2x boys. Suspected selfish Y-chromosome gene. One-off.

stories.label: Data centers racing to space — beyond national jurisdiction
stories.summary: Companies launching data centers into orbit, beyond regulation. Connected to AWS Dubai destruction story.

stories.label: US intelligence shared Khamenei location with Israel
stories.summary: US disclosed Khamenei's location to Israel. May violate Executive Order 12333.

stories.label: Argentina: Milei passes reform, pushing US 'strategic alliance'
stories.summary: Labor reform passed. Milei pushing 'strategic alliance' with US.

stories.label: Kenya rolls out free HIV prevention injection
stories.summary: Lenacapavir twice-yearly injection, free of charge.

stories.label: Syria three-front crisis — attention pulled by Iran war
stories.summary: Syria fighting on three fronts. Iran war diverting attention.

stories.label: Zimbabwe bans all raw mineral and lithium exports
stories.summary: Ban on raw minerals and lithium exports. Africa's largest lithium reserves.

stories.label: Islamic State using AI to resurrect dead leaders
stories.summary: IS using generative AI for synthetic media of dead leaders.
